visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man is seated in a dark airplane cabin, wearing large silver over-ear headphones and a yellow shirt. He is focused on a laptop and a small MIDI pad controller on his folding tray table. The background shows the interior of a premium cabin with ambient blue lighting and other empty seats visible in the shadows. (2) A closer perspective focuses on the man's hands as he rhythmically strikes the pads of a black MIDI controller. On his laptop screen, a music production software interface is visible, showing various audio tracks and meters. He wears a smart watch on his left wrist while he precisely manipulates the digital instruments. (3) The camera angle shifts to show him playing a compact white synthesizer keyboard. His right hand plays melodic lines while his left hand rests on the keyboard's chassis. The cabin environment remains dimly lit, highlighting the glow from the electronic devices and the entertainment screens in the distance. (4) The screen transitions to a split-view composition. The upper portion shows the man continuing to perform on his keyboard within the airplane cabin. The lower half displays a digital piano roll visualization from his DAW, where purple bars representing musical notes flow horizontally across the screen in sync with his playing.
